source: Fitalert Curated Plans (Boostcamp, StrongLifts, Bodybuilding.com, Thenx, PHUL, Athlean-X, NTC)

plans.title: Push / Pull / Legs (PPL)
plans.description: The gold-standard science-backed Push/Pull/Legs split popularized by Reddit Fitness and Boostcamp. Balances heavy compound progressions with high-volume isolation for maximal muscle growth and structural symmetry.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Retract scapulae, touch lower chest, press with leg drive.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.cue: Set bench at 30 degrees, full stretch at bottom, press without clanking.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Slight torso lean, lead with elbows, control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Machine Assisted Dips
exercises.cue: Keep torso slightly forward for chest, or upright for triceps.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar over midfoot, engage lats, push floor away through heels.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull elbows down into pockets, squeeze lats at clavicle level.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.cue: Keep elbows pinned to sides, avoid swinging hips.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.cue: Pull rope to eyes while externally rotating hands back.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Brace core 360 degrees, knees track over toes, break parallel.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Push hips back, keep dumbbells close to shins, feel hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Horizontal Leg Press
exercises.cue: Place feet shoulder-width, avoid letting lower back peel off pad.

exercises.name: Barbell Calf Raise
exercises.cue: 2-second pause at bottom stretch, explode onto balls of feet.

plans.title: StrongLifts 5x5 Strength Foundation
plans.description: The world famous 5x5 linear progression program from the StrongLifts app. Focuses on three full-body multi-joint barbell lifts per workout, alternating Workout A and Workout B, adding weight every single session.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Solid shelf on upper traps, deep breath into belly, squat below parallel.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Five points of contact, pinch shoulder blades, press in slight j-curve.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pull-Ups
exercises.cue: Chest up to the bar, squeeze scapulae down, controlled descent.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Keep knees pushed out in line with toes, chest proud.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes and abs, press straight past forehead, lock out overhead.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.cue: One heavy work set. Reset each rep on floor, drag bar up shins.

plans.title: Arnold Golden Era Split
plans.description: Inspired by Arnold Schwarzenegger's Golden Era high-volume bodybuilding workouts. Pairs opposing muscle groups (chest & back, shoulders & arms) for tremendous pumps, joint balance, and classic aesthetics.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Full chest expansion, flared lats, touch lower pec.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Wide grip, arch thoracic spine, pull bar to upper chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.cue: Target clavicular head, deep stretch, contract at peak.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Drive elbows toward ribs, full dead hang at bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Keep pinkies slightly elevated, reach hands outward.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.cue: Supinate wrists hard at top, keep elbows steady.

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.cue: Lower until 90 degree elbow bend, lockout triceps at top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Neutral palms, targets brachialis and forearms.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Smooth cadence, explosive ascent, keep torso angle rigid.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Load the hamstrings and glutes, keep neck neutral.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.cue: Elevate feet slightly, rotate through thoracic spine.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.cue: Opposite elbow to opposite knee with slow control.

plans.title: Thenx Calisthenics Mastery
plans.description: Created in the style of Chris Heria and the Thenx app. Master bodyweight control, relative strength, and gymnastic progressions using pull-up bars, dip bars, and floor work with zero gym membership required.

exercises.name: Dip Bar Dips / Bench Dips
exercises.cue: Keep shoulders depressed away from ears, descend to 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Explosive Push-Up
exercises.cue: Push off floor with explosive power, absorb softly on return.

exercises.name: Standard Floor Push-Up
exercises.cue: Rigid plank line from crown to heels, full chest lockout.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pull-Ups
exercises.cue: Pull chin clearly above bar, avoid kipping with legs.

exercises.name: Wide Grip Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Grip 1.5x shoulder width, drive elbows straight down.

exercises.name: Bear Plank Isometric Hold
exercises.cue: Knees hovering 2 inches off floor, brace core intensely.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.cue: Full depth, knees tracking outward, fast tempo.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on bench/chair, front knee stays behind toe tip.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.cue: Control the rotation, touch floor on each side.

plans.title: Athlean-X Functional Posture & Reset
plans.description: Physiotherapist-designed athletic mobility routine modeled on Athlean-X prehab principles. Fixes desk posture, opens thoracic spine, strengthens external rotators, and builds bulletproof joints.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.cue: Thumbs point back at finish, hold 2-second contraction.

exercises.name: Banded Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Focus on smooth scapulohumeral rhythm overhead.

exercises.name: Bear Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Push floor away through palms, protract shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Pry hips open with elbows at bottom of squat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Neutral spine, stretch posterior chain without rounding.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Step back softly, 90 degree angle on both knees.

plans.title: Nike Training Club HIIT Conditioning
plans.description: High-intensity athletic circuit inspired by Nike Training Club (NTC). Combines ballistic kettlebell swings, burpees, and core intervals to maximize VO2 max and burn calories in short, intense sessions.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.cue: Snap hips powerfully, kettlebell floats to chest height.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.cue: Chest touches floor, pop feet forward, vertical jump with clap.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.cue: Drive knees alternately toward chest like sprinting in place.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.cue: Stay light on balls of feet, keep rhythm brisk.

plans.title: PHUL (Power Hypertrophy Upper Lower)
plans.description: The acclaimed Power Hypertrophy Upper Lower system from Muscle & Strength. Dedicates the first two days to raw power and 3-5 rep sets, followed by two hypertrophy days focusing on 8-15 reps for optimal sarcoplasmic hypertrophy.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Heavy load, stay tight under the bar, drive with feet.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Heavy)
exercises.cue: Explosive pull to chest, 2-second negative.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.cue: Strict form, maximal bicep tension.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cue: Heavy sets, maintain torso stiffness and hit full depth.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.cue: Lock out hips forcefully without hyperextending back.

exercises.name: Barbell Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Heavy calf overload on balls of feet.

plans.title: Gentle Yoga & Recovery Flow
plans.description: A restorative parasympathetic nervous system recovery protocol inspired by Yoga with Adriene. Calms heart rate, elongates tight hip flexors and hamstrings, and promotes deep recovery between hard lifting days.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold (Malasana)
exercises.cue: Heels down if possible, hands in prayer, open hips gently.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Transition Hold
exercises.cue: Inhale as belly drops, exhale as spine domes up to ceiling.

exercises.name: Supported Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Breathe smoothly through nose, avoid holding breath.
